page: Microsoft Azure E112ias_v5 is an isolated virtual machine instance belonging to the EIASv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 112 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 56 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7763 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 32 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 672.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable for external disk attachments.

In benchmark evaluations, the E112ias_v5 demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, scoring 151080.86 in stress-ng multi-core tests and achieving a top-tier passmark memory score of 3140.79. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 566.51 GB/sec, and the passmark CPU encryption test registers in the top 10% at 119178.14. Single-core performance is strong, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2893.09. Large-block memory bandwidth tests show average performance, with read-only speeds at 126.71 GB/sec and write speeds at 62.78 GB/sec. For LLM inference, the instance processes 182.94 tokens/sec for medium 7B models but drops to 3.04 tokens/sec for text generation on large 70B models.

Given its high resource density, isolated hardware allocation, and lack of bundled local storage, the E112ias_v5 offers a specialized cost-efficiency profile suited for enterprise workloads requiring high memory capacity and dedicated compute resources without local disk overhead. The instance is highly suited for large-scale database operations, memory-intensive data processing, multi-threaded software compilation, and medium-scale LLM prompt processing.
